title: The Daily Commute
shared_passage: Listen to four commuters talk about their daily journeys to work. For questions 1 to 8, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: What does Piers say about the bus?
options: It takes him fifteen minutes to get to the bus stop.
He can often sit and relax on the bus.
He often cannot relax on the bus.

questions.question: What does Piers think about the underground?
options: It's sad and he hates it.
It's much better than driving.
He loves it, but only when he can sit.

questions.question: Sydney...
options: relaxes and watches the sunrise before going to work.
doesn't like loud music in the car.
drinks coffee on her way to work.

questions.question: Which is true about Sydney?
options: She always has to slow down due to speed cameras.
She always finds traffic jams when entering the city.
She sometimes feels her journey to work is too short.

questions.question: Brenda...
options: began to enjoy cycling in New York.
enjoys her bike ride to work but not so much the ferry.
enjoys both her bicycle and ferry ride.

questions.question: Brenda says that she...
options: has a plan B for her commute on certain days.
sometimes has no patience to wait for the ferry.
never takes the underground.

questions.question: Nick...
options: spends one hour in his car every day.
feels miserable about his daily commute.
turned his daily commute into an opportunity.

questions.question: Nick says that...
options: he often gets frustrated in traffic jams.
learning French might help him get a new job.
he likes his current job.
